description: This is a migration script for the Apache Superset project, specifically converting dashboard position JSON data from version 1 to version 2. It defines database models, layout generation functions, and a main upgrade function that processes dashboards in the database.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Declarative ORM class representing a dashboard slice, used in the upgrade process.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Declarative ORM class representing a dashboard, including its title, position JSON, and related slices.

methods.name: is_v2_dash
methods.description: Checks if the dashboard positions JSON indicates a version 2 dashboard.

methods.name: get_boundary
methods.description: Calculates the boundary coordinates of dashboard positions.

methods.name: generate_id
methods.description: Generates a short unique ID using UUID4.

methods.name: has_overlap
methods.description: Determines if dashboard positions overlap along the x or y axis.

methods.name: get_empty_layout
methods.description: Creates an initial empty layout structure for the dashboard.

methods.name: get_header_component
methods.description: Creates a header component with the dashboard title.

methods.name: get_row_container
methods.description: Creates a row container component.

methods.name: get_col_container
methods.description: Creates a column container component.

methods.name: get_chart_holder
methods.description: Creates a chart or markdown component based on position data.

methods.name: get_children_max
methods.description: Gets the maximum value of a specified attribute among child components.

methods.name: get_children_sum
methods.description: Sums a specified attribute across child components.

methods.name: get_wide_column_ids
methods.description: Filters column components that can have their width reduced.

methods.name: is_wide_leaf_component
methods.description: Checks if a component is a wide chart or markdown.

methods.name: can_reduce_column_width
methods.description: Determines if a column component's width can be reduced.

methods.name: reduce_row_width
methods.description: Reduces the width of the widest chart in a row.

methods.name: reduce_component_width
methods.description: Reduces the width of a wide leaf component.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Recursively converts position data into a nested layout structure.

methods.name: convert_to_layout
methods.description: Converts raw position data into a full dashboard layout.

methods.name: merge_position
methods.description: Adjusts position data to merge overlapping or adjacent positions.

methods.name: scan_dashboard_positions_data
methods.description: Processes raw position data to fix overlaps and assign proper row positions.
